data.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/scripts/classify-epic-class.sh using keyword heuristics to classify epic architectural class. Prior art: plugins/dso/scripts/brainstorm/classify-sc-shape.sh.

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/classify-epic-class.sh

## Classification Logic
- Input: epic ticket JSON (stdin) or --ticket-id flag
- Output: JSON {class: 'class:architectural|class:integration|class:infra|class:behavioral'}
- Keyword sets: schema/migration/DB → architectural; API/webhook/external-service → integration; deploy/infra/network → infra; default → behavioral
- No LLM call — pure bash+grep keyword matching

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/classify-epic-class.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-classify-epic-class.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)

## Testing Mode
RED (depends S4/T1)
